Nine modules forming the source import closure of Consequences were selected.
Wiener is truncated immediately before section auto_cheby (after WeakPNT).
The unrelated prelim_decay_2, AbsolutelyContinuous, prelim_decay_3 and decay_alt
block is omitted; it contained two unproved claims unused by WeakPNT.
Consequences is truncated after chebyshev_asymptotic.
Every file is migrated to the Lean module system with public imports and an
exposed public section. Compatibility changes are documented in migration notes.
